items:
Gritz Carlton ~ Scenic 30A Vacation Rental on Beach with Pool and Spa
Stay at 30A’s southern version of the Ritz-Carlton – Gritz Carlton in Gulf Place/Dune Allen Beach. This gorgeous Gulf front home is just the right mix of sugar white sand, emerald green water, and sweet Southern hospitality. Your stay places you directly on the beach where you enjoy not only the view but also the ocean breezes and the sound of the surf. There is private beach access from the house that places you directly on the sugar white beaches. There is also a heated pool /spa with jets that overlooks the gulf. As you exit US 98 onto Scenic 30A, you know immediately that you are in a special place with over 40% of the area protected from future developments with dune lakes, charming communities, white sands and emerald waters. Gulf Place offers an array of shopping, outdoor activities, festivals and events. Please note that this slice of paradise is only offered through VRBO and is not affiliated with any other third parties.
The house is situated about 23 feet above sea level, which offers spectacular views of sunsets and sun rises, standing two stories tall and spanning 3,300 square feet. This vacation home host five bedrooms, six and a half bathrooms and has accommodations for twelve of your friends or family members. Both floors are designed to host a whole family by itself with two living rooms, complete with bedrooms, bathrooms, a fully-equipped kitchen, and access to expansive balconies with sweeping Gulf views.
On the first floor of Gritz Carlton are four bedrooms each with a private bath. You will love the wet bar and large living room, ideal for evening entertainment with your whole group. The living room leads out onto a spacious, colonial style covered porch and the pool and spa in addition to the overlooks of the sugar white sand beaches and the emerald gulf. Enjoy your private beach access directly from the house. A truly divine sight you do not want to miss!
An elevator in the home provides easy access to the second floor and also makes hauling your items in much easier.
Venture up to the second floor to discover the en-suite master bedroom, complete with his and her bathrooms with a walk-in shower in one and a Jacuzzi tub in the other. Wake up to panoramic Gulf views. The second floor’s bright natural light is complemented with high vaulted-beam ceilings. End your day out on the second-floor wrap-around balcony, enjoying a colorful Gulf sunset.
Find instant private access to the Gulf, as well as a private, beachfront pool. Both the beautiful beach and the pool are the perfect addition to your Gritz Carlton experience.
Gritz Carlton is situated just east of Santa Rosa Beach Golf Club and within walking distance to Gulf Place with restaurants, shopping and an amphitheater and is nearby many things to do on 30A.

Sirens at the Beach and Sundog Books are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

reviews.text: The house was beautiful and inviting with large gathering spaces and plenty of bedrooms. The beds were comfortable and had plenty of pillows and blankets. We used the kitchen often, which was well stocked with appliances and all we needed for cooking and food storage. I especially liked the covered porches to sit outside and enjoy the view, while the kids all liked the pool, hot tub and beach access best. Gritz Carlton was the perfect home away from home for our Christmas vacation.
